records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decline in revenue was due to lower levels of global drilling activity affecting demand for the segment’s shorter cycle consumable products, partially offset by higher sales from the segment’s capital equipment offerings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Higher revenue out of backlog offset lower sales of aftermarket parts and services.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Improved profitability was driven by strong execution on higher-margin backlog.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: These changes are raising concerns for both supply and demand related challenges to global commodity markets, resulting in lower oil prices, significant market volatility, and greater uncertainty.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net income decreased 52 percent to $108 million, or $0.29 per share, and operating profit decreased 54 percent to $143 million, or 6.5 percent of sales.
